claim.claim-text: 2. The image processing apparatus as claimed in claim 1, wherein the flag is set as a parameter of a higher layer than a layer where the difference quantization parameter is provided in the bit stream.
3. The image processing apparatus as claimed in claim 2, wherein the setting unit is further configured to acquire the flag as a syntax of the bit stream.

4. The image processing apparatus as claimed in claim 3, wherein the difference quantization parameter is a difference value between the current quantization parameter for the current coding block and a previous quantization parameter for a previous coding block.

5. The image processing apparatus as claimed in claim 4, wherein the previous coding block is a coding block that is decoded immediately before the current coding block in the order the coded data are decoded.

6. The image processing apparatus as claimed in claim 3, wherein the difference quantization parameter is a difference value between the current quantization parameter set for the current coding block and another quantization parameter set for another coding block.
7. An image processing method performed by an image processing apparatus, the method comprising the steps of:

• a setting unit configured to set, based on a value indicating a minimum coding block size for which the difference quantization parameter is set, a current quantization parameter for a current coding block formed by block partitioning, which recursively splits a largest coding block into smaller coding blocks, and set a flag that specifies whether or not a difference quantization parameter is present in a bit stream, and • a quantization unit configured to quantize transform coefficient data based on the current quantization parameter to generate quantized data; and • an encoding unit configured to encode the quantized data to generate the bit stream including the flag.
9. The image processing apparatus as claimed in claim 8, wherein the flag is set as a parameter of a higher layer than a layer where the difference quantization parameter in the bit stream.
10. An image processing method performed by an image processing apparatus, the method comprising the steps of:

• setting, based on a value indicating a minimum coding block size for which the difference quantization parameter is set, a current quantization parameter for a current coding block formed by block partitioning, which recursively splits a largest coding block into smaller coding blocks, and setting a flag that specifies whether or not a difference quantization parameter is present in a bit stream, • quantizing transform coefficient data based on the current quantization parameter to generate quantized data; and • encoding the quantized data to generate the bit stream including the flag.
